title: I made a physics delivery game with Claude: get fragile cargo over hills without breaking it
author: Lower_Study594
selftext:
Play free in your browser (desktop + mobile): [https://rochestersoftware.itch.io/handle-with-hills-deluxe-delivery](https://rochestersoftware.itch.io/handle-with-hills-deluxe-delivery)



Your truck has no roof and no straps, so the cargo slides, bounces and smashes on every bump. Fishbowls shatter, beach balls bounce out, and a sleepy kitten jumps out at the first big hill 🐱



How it was made: Phaser 3 + Matter.js physics. Claude wrote the code and the art (it's all drawn in code, no image generators). Music and sound effects are licensed from human creators.



Features: truck upgrades, 4 drivers and 4 vehicles, 4 settings, road hazards (mud, ice, rope bridges, gap jumps), and a daily challenge.



Happy to answer questions about the process. Feedback very welcome!

comments.author: Lower_Study594
comments.body:
Hey everyone! I made this physics delivery game 🚚📦



Your truck has no roof and no straps, so the cargo slides, bounces and smashes on every bump. Fishbowls shatter on hard landings, beach balls bounce right out, cakes slide off, and the sleepy kitten jumps out at the first big hill 🐱



\- Lean in the air with gas/brake to land flat

\- Upgrade your engine, suspension, tire grip and bed walls

\- 4 settings: sunset town, moonlit suburbs, a desert canyon and snowy peaks

\- Road hazards like mud, ice, wobbly rope bridges and gap jumps

\- Works on desktop and mobile (turn your phone sideways)



Controls: D / → to drive, A / ← to brake (and to lean in the air)



It's free, no downloads. I'd love to hear which cargo gives you the most trouble, and anything that feels unfair or confusing!
